THE OFFICIAL WEBSITE OF AITKIN COUNTY, MINNESOTA
NORTHWOODS ATV TRAILS
The construction of the Northwoods ATV trails has been completed. What are you waiting for? Get out here and ride!
See the ATV Trails
LONG LAKE CONSERVATION CENTER
We are open! Long Lake Conservation Center is a resource for every person of every age. We have 760 acres of nature to explore including our 3 main hiking trails and our cross-country ski trail! If you are looking for a chance to get out in nature and take a break from the stresses of the world visit Long Lake Conservation Center.
Visit LLCC (opens in new tab)
COFFEE WITH THE COUNTY
Bite-sized weekly updates and insights about the County, Departments and Employees. Grab your coffee and tune in for a few minutes of connection and news with your county.
Listen Here to the Aitkin County podcast
ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT
Building a Prosperous Future. Discover the thriving opportunities and initiatives driving Aitkin County's economic growth. Together, we're fostering a dynamic environment for businesses, investors, and residents to flourish.

Vision
We strive to be a county of safe, vibrant communities that place value on good stewardship of local resources.
Mission
To provide outstanding service in a fiscally responsible manner through innovation and collaboration with respect for all.
Core Values
We achieve outstanding customer service through these core values: Collaboration, Innovation, Integrity, People-Focused, and Professionalism.
AITKIN COUNTY STRATEGIC PLAN 2025 - 2028
Strategic Plan Now Available
Aitkin County is proud to present our new Strategic Plan for 2025 - 2028. This comprehensive plan outlines our vision, goals, and strategic initiatives for the next four years.
